class.name: XMLElement
class.brief_description: A view of one element of an [XML] tree.

method.name: add_child
method.description: Adds [param element] as the last child of this element. The child then belongs to this tree. An element can't be its own child.

method.name: find_all
method.description: Returns all descendants that match [param path]: element names separated by [code]/[/code], relative to this element. Returns an empty array if there is no match.

method.name: find_first
method.description: Returns the first descendant that matches [param path]: element names separated by [code]/[/code], relative to this element. Returns [code]null[/code] if there is no match.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns the value of the attribute [param name], or [param default] if the element has no such attribute.

method.name: get_attributes
method.description: Returns a copy of all attributes as a [Dictionary] of attribute name to value. Changing the copy does not change the tree; use [method set_attribute].

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns the child elements in document order. Text nodes are not included; see [member text].

method.name: get_children_by_name
method.description: Returns the child elements with the tag name [param name] in document order.

method.name: has_attribute
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the element has the attribute [param name].

method.name: remove_attribute
method.description: Removes the attribute [param name]. Does nothing if the element has no such attribute.

method.name: remove_child
method.description: Removes [param element] from the children of this element. Prints an error if it is not a child.

method.name: set_attribute
method.description: Sets the attribute [param name] to [param value]. Prints an error if [param name] is empty.

members.member: The tag name of the element.
The text of the direct text children of the element, joined together. Setting it replaces all text nodes of the element and keeps its child elements.
